key_insight: Convex conjugacy reformulates logistic-regression poisoning exactly, making stationarity affine and isolating nonconvexity in bounded bilinear equalities.
engineering_relevance: The reformulation enables solver-based analysis of poisoning attacks on ℓ₂-regularized logistic regression and strengthens reported optimization bounds.
method: Use strong convexity to replace the defender’s optimization problem with first-order optimality conditions.
Replace sigmoid relations with a convex optimality-gap inequality via softplus conjugacy, and express the attack objective as concave.
Change variables to make stationarity affine, then bound bilinear variables using global estimates and convex preprocessing.
evidence_signal: Experiments on eight binary classification datasets found that locally optimized attacks degraded predictive performance on most datasets, while the convex-analytic formulation yielded substantially stronger reported dual bounds in SCIP within a fixed time limit.
watch_item: Bilinear constraints remain nonconvex, so stronger dual bounds do not imply globally optimal attacks within the time limit.
paper_title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
